decisions.reason: The hierarchical search bundle got only a brief mention in 2018 and has not appeared on the website since, so the uncertainty has resolved toward low value and the option is no longer worth holding.

VueTOC was featured once on the home page but has not been visible since, which suggests it was superseded or absorbed into broader mobile offerings, so maintaining it separately yields little further information or value.

The software platform is the firm's flagship and strategic base for further enterprise geospatial solutions, a core commitment rather than a marginal option, so it should be kept despite little recent website visibility.

The search extension sits close to the core web map offer, costs little to maintain alongside the platform, and once had its own page, so keeping it open remains cheap even though its value is still unconfirmed.
